10.01.2025, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following:
 2025:Ker:4311
Rp No. 1285 Of 2024
 :-2-:
 Order
This review petition has been filed by the review petitioners, who are appellants in MACA, seeking review of judgment dated 30.09.2024 in MACA 743/2017.

2. The review petitioners submit that the claimants are entitled for a compensation of a sum of 5 lakh under Section 164(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (for short 'the Act') and while awarding compensation, this Court omitted to grant compensation under Section 164(1) of the Act.
3.
The claim petition was filed under Section 166 of the Act and hence the claimants are not entitled to get compensation under Section 164(1) of the Act.
The tribunal as well as this Court has rightly awarded compensation treating the claim under Section 166 of the Act.
4. I do not find any error apparent on the face of the record calling for review of the judgment dated 30.09.2024.
Accordingly, the review petition is dismissed.

Sd/-
SHOBA ANNAMMA EAPEN JUDGE MBS/
